objectives: 學習使用基本的電子電路儀器，培養對電子電路分析和偵錯的基本能力。
content:
◎認識實驗設備( Introduction to Experiments )
1、專業倫理、實驗及儀器介紹( Professional Ethics and Introduction to the Experiments and the Instruments )
◎基本電路學( Basic Circuit Theory )
2、歐姆定律及電錶量測 ( Ohm’s Law and Multimeter )
3、Kirchhoff電壓及電流定律  ( Kirchhoff’s Voltage Law and Kirchhoff’s Current Law )
4、戴維寧、諾頓與重疊定理   ( Thevenin‘s Theorem, Norton‘s Theorem and the Principle of Superposition )
5、RC電路的暫態響應   ( Transient Response of RC Circuits)
6、RC、RL、RLC之線路響應   ( Response of RC, RL and RLC Circuits )
7、相位量測及頻率響應   ( Phase Measure and Frequency Response )
◎基本電子元件及電路( Basic Electronic Devices and Circuits )
8、二極體的特性曲線及整流電路  ( Diode characteristics and Diode Circuits )
9、二極體的應用電路   ( Advanced Diode circuits )
10、電晶體的特性曲線    ( Junction Transistor characteristics )
grading_policy:
Reports & Experiments   60%
Final operation test	20%
Final examination	20%
